description: Capstone knowledge base: import, index, cited Q&A, JSON logs. Feedback, in-app reset, and benchmark scripts are not in this tree.

features.name: Window Launch
features.description: Electron app opens a BrowserWindow with correct dimensions, preload script, and secure webPreferences
features.evidence: main.ts creates a 1200x800 BrowserWindow with contextIsolation=true, nodeIntegration=false, and the preload script. Development and packaged runs both load dist/renderer/index.html.

features.name: Document List Panel
features.description: Left sidebar shows imported documents with an Indexed marker and an empty state
features.evidence: DocumentList.tsx renders the title, size, and Indexed when status is indexed. Empty copy is shown when the list is empty.

features.name: Document Import
features.description: Import .txt and .md files. The Import button opens a native file dialog. Titles come from the first Markdown heading. Size limit is 10 MB.
features.evidence: Import calls documents.import() with no path; ipc-handlers opens dialog.showOpenDialog. importDocument rejects other extensions and files over 10 MB. retrieval-plan.md imports as title Retrieval Plan. meeting-summary.txt imports as meeting-summary. Checked by constructing the services, 2026-10-15.

features.name: Document Detail with Delete
features.description: Detail shows metadata and chunks, indexes the document, and deletes it after confirmation
features.evidence: DocumentDetail reloads chunks when status or chunk count changes, awaits indexing, and confirms before delete. deleteDocument removes the copy, content file, chunk file, and index-meta entry. The service delete was checked 2026-10-15; the confirm dialog was not clicked in a window.

features.name: Text Indexing
features.description: Documents are split into ~500 character chunks at paragraph boundaries. Single and batch indexing write index-meta.json and set status to indexed.
features.evidence: indexOne writes chunks/<id>.json, index-meta.json, and updateDocument({ status: indexed, chunks }). The retrieval-plan sample produced 5 non-empty chunks and status indexed.

features.name: Grounded Q&A with Citations
features.description: Ask a question and get the best-matching mock answer, up to two citations, and a confidence score
features.evidence: bestPattern picks the pattern with the most keyword hits. The fixed indexing question returned the 500-character paragraph answer, confidence 0.85, and two Retrieval Plan citations.

features.name: Conversation History
features.description: Flat list of saved questions and answers, with citation count, confidence, timestamp, and Clear History
features.evidence: ConversationHistory loads qa.history() and clearHistory() empties the list. The ask path appends to qa-history.json. The list is not a chat layout and has no feedback buttons.

features.name: Feedback Collection
features.description: Rate a Q&A response and keep that rating
features.evidence: No FeedbackEntry type, no feedback IPC channel, and no rating control.

features.name: Structured JSON Logging
features.description: Services emit JSON log lines with timestamp, level, service, message, and optional data
features.evidence: logger.ts writes one JSON object per line. Import, index, and ask logged INFO lines in the service check. Read IPC handlers log at DEBUG. LOG_LEVEL filters by level.

features.name: Clean State Reset
features.description: A control that deletes the data directory and returns the UI to empty
features.evidence: No app:reset channel and no Reset button. The unused resetAll method was removed. Empty the library by deleting the directory printed in Data directories initialized.

features.name: Full Persistence
features.description: Documents, chunks, index metadata, and Q&A history are stored as files under the user-data directory
features.evidence: PersistenceService writes documents-meta.json, content/<id>.txt, documents/<filename>, chunks/<id>.json, index-meta.json, and qa-history.json. A restart of the window was not re-run in this pass.

features.name: Status Bar
features.description: Shows index status, document count, and last import time
features.evidence: IndexingService.getStatus returns AppStatus. StatusBar reads indexStatus, documentsLoaded, and lastActivity. The bar was not screenshotted in this pass.

features.name: Benchmark Scripts
features.description: A shell suite for import, index, and query timing
features.evidence: scripts/benchmark.sh is not in this tree. benchmark-tasks.md is the manual five-task set.

features.name: Cleanup Scanner
features.description: A script that reports orphaned content, chunks, and metadata
features.evidence: scripts/cleanup-scanner.sh is not in this tree.

features.name: Harness files match the app
features.description: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, feature_list.json, init.sh, session-handoff.md, clean-state-checklist.md, evaluator-rubric.md, quality-document.md, and docs/ describe this tree
features.evidence: Those files are present. init.sh checks them plus scripts/dev.js and the three sample documents. It does not require benchmark or cleanup scripts.
